parameters.query: SELECT commerce.create_transaction($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::char(3), $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb) as transaction_id, $7::jsonb as input, 'created'::text as transaction_resolution;

WITH requested AS (SELECT $1::uuid as transaction_id, $2::text as business_id, $3::jsonb as input), transaction_data AS (SELECT t.* FROM commerce.transactions t INNER JOIN requested r ON r.transaction_id = t.id AND r.business_id = t.business_id) SELECT r.transaction_id, r.business_id, r.input, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as transaction_found, CASE WHEN t.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('transaction', to_jsonb(t), 'items', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) ORDER BY i.created_at) FROM commerce.transaction_items i WHERE i.transaction_id = t.id), '[]'::jsonb)) END as transaction_context FROM requested r LEFT JOIN transaction_data t ON t.id = r.transaction_id;
